purpose: Validate a deployment interface where none of the five computing parties receives a plaintext probe or threshold
client: A trusted external query client deals an independent degree-two polynomial per input field; each computing party gets exactly one evaluation over a private channel
reconstruction: Secret-wire weighted sum with public Lagrange weights5,-10,10,-5,1. No reconstructed probe is opened.
state: Same actual per-party own-share-file state, stable secret handles, masked templates, full relation check and vectorized private candidate operator
security_scope: Fixed at-most-two passive computing-party corruption; honest binary-query client. This is an input-interface refinement, not a new malicious-security claim.
validation: All field reconstruction checked by client fixture; N8 transition/indexed membership agreement, exact accept/reject, rollback/reload; N128 whole-state and query oracle
measurement: Five alternating N128 stored-state full-query repetitions versus the trusted-owner-input interface, plus one warmup each; same persistent state, no rekey between query trials
accounting: Report client dealing time and nominal client-share bytes separately; include all server execution/input costs in VM/wall metrics
